scope: Isolated compiler measurements, not complete preparation timings or gameplay FPS.
execution: Packaged Bionic ARM64 Clang, app UID through run-as; shell scheduling group, launcher backgrounded. Other foreground workload and thermal conditions were not controlled.

sample.selection: Evenly spaced across the sorted generated MANAGER functions, excluding registration and individual sources over 256 KiB.

compiler.pch: Same existing full MANAGER PCH for every sample
compiler.flags: Identical PIC, section, include and runtime macro flags in all variants

memory_note: Peak sum of compiler child RSS, in KiB; shared mappings can be counted more than once. This is not app PSS or a whole-preparation memory bound.

registration_sample.scope: The exact original phone-generated MANAGER registration map was re-emitted compactly on the host for this isolated benchmark; these files were not used by the ISO-only app preparation.
registration_sample.equivalence: All 26,889 mapped PCs, handlers, bounds and holes matched.

full_preparation: Pending on the optimized APK. Frozen batch reuse, projected declarations and comment suppression were not enabled in the isolated throughput samples.
